name: animation-tick-batch-on-a-128-rig-crowd
subject: PRD-828 Phase 2: 128 single-clip rigs that each crossed into the engine four times a frame now cross once for the whole crowd. Run with TN_BENCH_TARGET=web-engine and ?crowdCount=128&crowdRate=auto so the page is the owned Wasm engine and publishes TN_FRAME_BUDGET windows.

engineCost.source: One batch advances the frame's whole crowd. Two allows a frame that settles a queued tick and then queues the next; a reader that settles the queue mid-frame turns one batch into one per rig, which is the failure this bound exists to catch.
